history.summary: A BAPS (Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan) mandir on Shastri Yagnapurushdas Marg, Atladara. BAPS's own commemorative account dates the mandir's origin to the pilgrimage of its founder Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj, who walked to this site on Tritiya of Ashadh Sud, Vikram Samvat 2001 (1945 CE); the mandir celebrated its 80th Patotsav in June 2025 with a 6,000-devotee padayatra from 32 locations, per Bhaskar English. The present complex is a modern shikharbaddh mandir with carved walls depicting Shiva, Krishna and other figures; the exact consecration year of the current structure is not confirmed in the sources consulted - flagged. Main idols per Thrillophilia are Swaminarayan and Gunatitanand Swami; an associated BAPS Swaminarayan Vidyamandir (school, est. 2005) stands nearby on Padra Road - do not confuse the two. Note a smaller BAPS centre at 'Madhusagar Society, off Vadsar Bridge' is a separate local satsang hall, not this mandir. Timing sources conflict (6:00 AM-8:30 PM Triphobo; 7:30 AM-8:30 PM Thrillophilia; Justdial opens 7:30 AM) - verify locally.
